subject: HW onramp handshake: harmonize OEM quotes + cloud backstop
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial capacity ask for CastleAI — numbers + asks

Tessa / Karthik,

Quick context: CastleAI is close on a Dedicated + Hosted hybrid commitment. They want a committed dedicated pool for model inference (initially 64x A100-equivalent GPUs) with the option to burst to cloud while we ramp hardware. Key constraints:
- Target go-live: production at scale by Sep 15 (Q3).
- Desired committed units: 64 GPUs on day 1, scale to 128 over 12 weeks after go-live.
- They want vendor-level ETAs (OEM) and a cloud backstop for the first 8–10 weeks.

Can you:
1) Confirm realistic procurement lead times if we route OEM via Orca or similar (how soon can we realistically get 64 units on site if we pull the trigger today?)
2) Outline a tranche-based onramp schedule we can propose (what to reserve vs cloud-only backfill)
3) Call out any premium lanes / expedite costs and deposit requirements we should expect

Attached: ACME_onramp_forecast_v1.xlsx (counts / traffic projections).

Goal: produce a one-page vendor ask we can send to Orca + Nimbus Cloud next day.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial capacity ask for CastleAI — numbers + asks

Thanks Ben — summary and suggested approach below. Forwarding to Natalie (Orca) and Nimbus to get hard ETAs/pricing. Laura, pls track procurement steps once quotes arrive.

High-level proposal:
- Tranche A (Committed): 64 GPUs reserved in a Dedicated pool (vendor-provisioned or co-lo) by Sep 15.
- Tranche B (Scale): +64 GPUs to hit 128 over 12 weeks after go-live — mix of additional dedicated reservations + cloud bursts as needed.
- Backstop: Nimbus cloud to provide burst capacity for up to 8 weeks while OEM lead times resolve; pricing/commit to be confirmed.

Action items for vendors (to include in ask):
- OEM (Orca): provide earliest ship window for 64 units, premium expedite option (8–10 wk) vs standard (12–18 wk), deposit %, cancellation terms, and any customs/port risks. Attach a sample quote.
- Cloud (Nimbus): confirm short-term burst capacity availability (us-west region), per-hour tokenized pricing for the burst, minimum commitment, and ramp billing model.

Risk callouts:
- Customs/ETA variance — we need a contingency credit or cloud buffer if hardware slips >3 weeks.
- Licensing/firmware tie-ins — certain OEM SKUs may require additional firmware licensing which affects cost/lead time.

I'll draft a single vendor email and loop both providers. Ben — can you push CastleAI procurement to confirm if they'll accept a staged start (Committed + cloud backstop) and whether a 30% deposit is acceptable?

Attaching: procurement_action_items.md (action list).

Tessa Morgan
Head, Dedicated Onramp Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Natalie Orlova <natalie@orca-oem.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@castleai.com
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 14:22:00 +0200
Subject: Orca SKU availability + preliminary quote (ref: CastleAI)

Hi Tessa / team — thanks for the ask. Quick preliminary availability and pricing notes for Orca A100-P equivalent SKUs: 

- Standard lane: 12–18 weeks from PO to customer site (standard shipping).
- Priority lane (limited slots): 8–10 weeks from PO to site with 30% deposit and expedited processing; additional 8% expedite fee on top of list price.
- We can hold a 64-unit tranche for 10 business days on a signed LOI + 30% deposit. After that, allocations are on a first-come-first-served basis.

Conditions that affect ETA: customs backlog at major West Coast ports, final SKU (firmware-enabled units take additional 7–10 days), and customer-specific integration services (racked + tested onsite adds 5–7 days).

Attached: Orca_Quote_20280528.pdf (line-item pricing, expedite fee, terms).

If CastleAI can sign LOI and commit the deposit by June 8, we can target the priority lane and aim for mid-August delivery for the 64-unit tranche.

Best,
Natalie Orlova
Account Director — Strategic OEM Accounts
Orca Systems
From: Nimbus Cloud Sales <nimbus-cloud-sales@cloudco.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 31 May 2028 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: RE: HW onramp handshake: harmonize OEM quotes + cloud backstop

Hi all — Nimbus can provide burst capacity in us-west-2 as a short-term backfill. Summary: 
- Capacity: up to 128 A100-equivalent GPU hours available per day for up to 10 weeks while dedicated hardware arrives.
- Pricing: $X.XX per GPU-hour (list); we can offer a blended rate for the 8–10 week window if a single purchase order covers the period.
- Minimum commitment: 4 weeks billing guarantee for burst pool; no long-term reservation required.
- Onboarding: 48–72 hours to enable the account and route traffic once PO is in.

We recommend pairing an ORCA LOI (to reserve hardware) + a Nimbus short-term purchase order that covers the first 6 weeks at a blended burst rate. Happy to draft a simple SOW and attach pricing.

Regards,
Nimbus Cloud Sales Team
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Natalie Orlova <natalie@orca-oem.com>, Nimbus Cloud Sales <nimbus-cloud-sales@cloudco.com>, procurement@castleai.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jun 2028 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: HW onramp handshake: harmonize OEM quotes + cloud backstop

Thanks everyone — good forward motion. Summary / next steps: 

1) CastleAI decision + deposit (Ben): confirm by EOD June 8 whether they approve 30% deposit to secure Orca priority lane. If yes, Ben to share signed LOI and procurement contact.
2) Orca (Natalie): share final PDF quote + DocuSign link with payment terms; include explicit shipping window range and cancellation policy.
3) Nimbus: provide a one-page SOW and blended burst pricing for a 6–8 week bridging window; include onboarding SLA (48–72 hrs).
4) Redwood internal: Tessa to draft vendor package (one-pager) and procurement_action_items.md; Laura to create procurement ticket and track approvals.

If CastleAI is unable to accept the deposit by June 8, we should prepare an alternative: negotiate shorter Nimbus commitment and split the tranche (32 on day 1 + cloud burst) to reduce immediate shipping risk.

I'll drop a HubSpot note and add the DocuSign/PO links to the deal record.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
